crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin ETFs see $399M net outflows as BTC tests support
crypto_headlines.summary: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust had a $405.3M outflow on Nov 2, its largest in over four months, and U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $399M in net outflows. BTC traded near $76,800 early on midterm election day.

crypto_headlines.title: Strategy adds 811 BTC, Strive adds 124 BTC
crypto_headlines.summary: Strategy bought 811 BTC for $65.5M (average $80,846), bringing its total to 849,327 BTC. Strive added 124 BTC for $10M, reaching 43,124 BTC.

crypto_headlines.title: Mercado Bitcoin halts services after $38M hot wallet breach
crypto_headlines.summary: Brazil's largest crypto exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after a hot wallet breach, says it will cover the $38M affected, and about $11M has been recovered so far with help from partners including Tether.

crypto_headlines.title: SOL slips below $100 for the first time in two months
crypto_headlines.summary: Solana traded around $92 after three daily closes below $95.70, even as the network set a record of 3.3 billion non-vote transactions in October.

crypto_headlines.title: Tether burns $2B of USDT on Ethereum
crypto_headlines.summary: Tether removed $2B of USDT from Ethereum circulation; the net reduction held by public users was roughly $464M.

crypto_headlines.title: Tokenized equities hit a $3.8B record
crypto_headlines.summary: Onchain tokenized stocks reached $3.8B, up 590% this year after ten straight weeks of gains.

doginal_news.title: 21 Japanese equities live on Pyth Pro
doginal_news.summary: Real-time prices for Japanese stocks including Toyota, Sony, Nintendo and Tokyo Electron are now available through Pyth Pro.

doginal_news.title: Free Legends Battle tournament tonight
doginal_news.summary: Single-elimination Doginal Dogs Legends TCG tournament on Tue Nov 3 at 7:30 PM ET, free to enter.

doginal_news.title: Hacked holders get replacement dogs
doginal_news.summary: JJXMeta thanked Shield, Bark and GodsBurnt after Shield gifted a replacement Doginal Dog to replace one lost in a wallet hack.

doginal_news.title: Community rallies around those affected by the hack
doginal_news.summary: Abrahammetaa highlighted Bark, Shield and GodsBurnt giving replacement dogs to members affected by the hack.

doginal_news.title: Legends TCG headed to DD Miami Dec 7
doginal_news.summary: Andmetax invited people to see the Legends TCG cards in person at DD Miami on Dec 7.
